cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Confess Around Them
cards.instruction: Use partial admissions to make a reciprocal confession feel like the only missing piece.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I changed the meeting time. Did you change the room? I taught you to put every alteration on the same notice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, on the calendar, not the notice. You're checking the details now; good. That's my part of why nobody met.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I thought you'd object to an earlier start. There's the reason I left out. Now give me yours, the way I taught you to complete a report: where did you send the others?

reason: Make actual pupil instruction, correction and qualified praise affect the exact Drive. Replace analytical ending with disclosure, reciprocal question, planned next action, claimed prediction evidence or explicit changed-term comparison.
